7448476.baseName: Habitat Pack of 12 Shatterproof 12 Days of Christmas Bauble
7448476.variantName: Habitat Pack of 12 Shatterproof 12 Days of Christmas Bauble
7448476.sourceDescription: Bring the beloved Christmas carol to life on your tree this year. This set gives you 12 colourful baubles, each one featuring a design and number from the classic 12 Days of Christmas song. From the partridge in a pear tree through to the lords a-leaping, you're getting a collection that tells the full festive story across your branches. They're pre-strung and ready to hang straight out of the box, making decorating quick and hassle-free. The durable plastic construction means they'll survive accidental knocks and tumbles, so you can enjoy the same cheerful designs year after year without worry. It's a playful way to add storytelling charm to your celebrations while keeping things practical for busy family homes. . 12 decorations included.; Contains pre-threaded baubles.; Size H6, W6, D6cm.; Made from plastic.; Shatterproof.; Suitable for indoor usage.

pf3zry20.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
pf3zry20.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
pf3zry20.sourceDescription: This decorative LED string light is designed to elevate your home environment with a touch of modern elegance. Emitting a warm, soft glow, it’s an aesthetically pleasing addition to any setting, whether used to adorn your living room, garden, or terrace. The cone-shaped design, paired with its vibrant green hue, ensures that the string light both complements and enhances the festive ambiance during special occasions like Christmas. Materials: Constructed from PVC, this string light blends durability with flexibility, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings. The steel components enhance its robustness, ensuring it withstands seasonal use while maintaining its structural integrity. The materials chosen guarantee a long-lasting decorative appeal without compromising on the modern aesthetic. Included Components: The set features LED decorative string lights that bring a warm white illumination to any space. The lights are USB-powered, which adds convenience, allowing for easy connectivity and versatility in positioning. This feature ensures users enjoy a seamless and energy-efficient lighting experience for any occasion. Features /Function /Design: Notable for its decorative design, the string light flaunts a modern aesthetic with clean, minimalistic lines. The USB functionality broadens its adaptability, making it easy to integrate into existing decor or for seasonal embellishments. This thoughtful design enhances the user experience with practicality and style. Recommended Uses: The lights are ideal for use in living rooms, gardens, and terraces, where they add warmth and festivity. Whether used for family gatherings or quiet evenings, the lights create a soothing ambiance tailored for enjoyment and relaxation. Care &Maintenance: To ensure longevity, follow the assembly instructions carefully. The USB connection should be handled with care, and lights should be stored in a dry place when not in use to maintain their quality. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 680 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xArtificialChristmastree,1xStand,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,20x3cmball,21x4cmball,20x6cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

g5tmtgb7.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come.
